plugins.name: Citizens 2
plugins.description: Citizens is a powerful NPC plugin for Minecraft Java servers. Create custom NPCs for your lobby, shop, quests, guides, and more. Easy to use, lightweight, and perfect for Paper/Spigot servers.

plugins.name: EssentialsX
